LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions, part of Strand 13 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Which words show direction and time? 2. Why is it important to show time and direction?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. underline prepositions of time, place and direction in sample sentences:

2. time such as in, on, at

3. place such as: in, on, at

4. direction such as: into, towards, to, through,

5. play preposition games and songs online/offline,

6. construct sentences using prepositions individually,

7. watch videos and online material on prepositions collaboratively,

8. create display charts containing prepositions of time and direction,

9. create crossword puzzles using prepositions,

10. solve code words and crossword puzzles involving prepositions,

11. search for prepositions online, from newspapers magazines among others. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. underline prepositions of time, place and direction in sample sentences:
2. time such as in, on, at
3. place such as: in, on, at
4. direction such as: into, towards, to, through,
5. play preposition games and songs online/offline,
6. construct sentences using prepositions individually,
7. watch videos and online material on prepositions collaboratively,
8. create display charts containing prepositions of time and direction,
9. create crossword puzzles using prepositions,
10. solve code words and crossword puzzles involving prepositions,
11. search for prepositions online, from newspapers magazines among others. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility is inculcated as the learner takes initiative to display charts containing prepositions of time and

direction.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills Education – Effective communication is enhanced as the learner uses prepositions accurately in

communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the knowledge of preposition to similar concepts learnt in Kiswahili.
